description: Inner-benchmark tasks consumed by the PromptPotter connector's extract_experiment hook. Each task is one inner-cycle invocation; the outer L1's score for a candidate is composited (per campaign.json::scoring) over three proxy metrics per task: first_round_delta, after_N_rounds_delta, rounds_to_N. These now read the inner cycle's best-DISCOVERED candidate (the θ-LCB of the best candidate the inner search FOUND, discounted by its own SE against winner's-curse), NOT the best it CROWNED — because at any feasible inner sample budget the conservative θ-LCB election rarely crowns, so reading the crowned frontier fed the outer ~zero signal even when the inner loop plainly found better candidates. The whole trajectory is computed in ONE space (θ-implied ability where the ruler is warm, else raw accuracy) so no delta subtracts across scales, and levels are NOT floored at origin, so a regressing meta-prompt yields a negative delta the outer can steer away from (the outer formula is recentred (delta+1)/2 so regression < no-op < improvement all stay distinct instead of piling at the [0,1] clamp). Inner benchmark = justlogic depth-6/7 (~0.44 origin, clear headroom; gsm8k retired — its origin aces target). Target 0.60 so rounds_to_N varies rather than saturating; paper ceiling on this stratum ~0.81. n_samples_per_inner_round = 24, scored IN FULL per candidate (inner_recursion sets sp_budget_ttest = bank size): drawing more samples than we score just widens the θ-LCB and starves the signal, so draw == measure. 2 inner rounds keeps a full-bank run inside the inner spend cap (lifted to 0.05 in inner_recursion) and the $1 outer cap. PANEL = 8 seeds: 2-failure margin over the elimination_n_min (6) coverage floor so one flaky inner tail doesn't waste the run.
